class EmailScreen(BaseScreen):
    title_text = 'GMAIL READER'

    def build(self):
        self.content.add_widget(Label(text='Number of emails to read:',
                                      color=(0.8, 0.8, 0.8, 1), size_hint_y=None, height='22dp'))
        self.count = Factory.HedesInput(text='10', input_filter='int')
        self.content.add_widget(self.count)
        btn = Factory.HedesButton(text='FETCH AND SUMMARIZE')
        btn.bind(on_press=lambda x: confirm_popup(
            'Read emails', 'Allow Hedes to read your Gmail inbox (read-only)?', self.fetch))
        self.content.add_widget(btn)
        self.scroll, self.out = output_view('Results appear here after fetching.')
        self.content.add_widget(self.scroll)

    def fetch(self):
        self.out.text = 'Loading inbox...'
        cfg = load_config()
        try:
            n = max(1, int(self.count.text or '10'))
        except ValueError:
            n = 10
        run_async(lambda: read_emails(cfg, n), lambda res: setattr(self.out, 'text', res))


class SlackScreen(BaseScreen):
    title_text = 'SLACK POSTER'

    def build(self):
        self.content.add_widget(Label(text='Channel:', color=(0.8, 0.8, 0.8, 1),
                                      size_hint_y=None, height='22dp'))
        self.channel = Factory.HedesInput(text=load_config()['slack_channel'])
        self.content.add_widget(self.channel)
        self.content.add_widget(Label(text='Message:', color=(0.8, 0.8, 0.8, 1),
                                      size_hint_y=None, height='22dp'))
        self.message = Factory.HedesInput(multiline=True, height='110dp')
        self.content.add_widget(self.message)
        btn = Factory.HedesButton(text='SEND MESSAGE')
        btn.bind(on_press=lambda x: self.ask())
        self.content.add_widget(btn)
        self.scroll, self.out = output_view('')
        self.content.add_widget(self.scroll)

    def ask(self):
        msg = self.message.text.strip()
        if not msg:
            self.out.text = 'Type a message first.'
            return
        confirm_popup('Post to Slack',
                      'Send this message to ' + self.channel.text + '?\n\n' + msg[:120],
                      lambda: self.send(msg))

    def send(self, msg):
        cfg = load_config()
        self.out.text = 'Sending...'
        run_async(lambda: post_slack(cfg, msg, self.channel.text.strip()), self.done)

    def done(self, res):
        self.out.text = res
        if res.startswith('Message posted'):
            self.message.text = ''


class FilesScreen(BaseScreen):
    title_text = 'FILE ORGANIZER'

    def build(self):
        self.content.add_widget(Label(
            text='Files are organized only inside the sandboxed workspace folder of this app.',
            color=(0.75, 0.75, 0.75, 1), size_hint_y=None, height='40dp'))
        b1 = Factory.HedesButton(text='ORGANIZE WORKSPACE')
        b1.bind(on_press=lambda x: confirm_popup(
            'Organize files', 'Sort all loose files in workspace into type folders?', self.run_org))
        self.content.add_widget(b1)
        b2 = Factory.HedesButton(text='CREATE SAMPLE FILES')
        b2.bind(on_press=lambda x: setattr(self.out, 'text', make_samples()))
        self.content.add_widget(b2)
        self.scroll, self.out = output_view('No actions yet.')
        self.content.add_widget(self.scroll)

    def run_org(self):
        self.out.text = 'Organizing...'
        run_async(organize_files, lambda res: setattr(self.out, 'text', res))


class WebScreen(BaseScreen):
    title_text = 'WEBSITE CHECK'

    def build(self):
        self.content.add_widget(Label(text='URL (must match your allowlist):',
                                      color=(0.8, 0.8, 0.8, 1), size_hint_y=None, height='22dp'))
        self.url = Factory.HedesInput(text='https://example.com')
        self.content.add_widget(self.url)
        btn = Factory.HedesButton(text='CHECK STATUS')
        btn.bind(on_press=lambda x: self.run())
        self.content.add_widget(btn)
        self.scroll, self.out = output_view('')
        self.content.add_widget(self.scroll)

    def run(self):
        cfg = load_config()
        target = self.url.text.strip()
        if not target:
            self.out.text = 'Enter a URL first.'
            return
        self.out.text = 'Checking...'
        run_async(lambda: check_website(cfg, target), lambda res: setattr(self.out, 'text', res))


class AuditScreen(BaseScreen):
    title_text = 'AUDIT LOG'

    def build(self):
        self.scroll, self.out = output_view('')
        self.content.add_widget(self.scroll)

    def on_pre_enter(self, *args):
        if not AUDIT:
            self.out.text = 'No actions recorded yet this session.'
        else:
            lines = [e['time'] + '  ' + e['action'] + '  -  ' + e['detail'] for e in AUDIT]
            self.out.text = '\n'.join(lines)


class SetupScreen(BaseScreen):
    title_text = 'SETUP'

    def build(self):
        cfg = load_config()
        self.fields = {}
        labels = [
            ('slack_token', 'Slack bot token'),
            ('slack_channel', 'Slack channel'),
            ('gmail_client_id', 'Gmail OAuth client id'),
            ('gmail_client_secret', 'Gmail OAuth client secret'),
            ('gmail_refresh_token', 'Gmail refresh token'),
            ('allowed_domains', 'Allowed domains (comma separated)'),
        ]
        scroll = ScrollView()
        inner = BoxLayout(orientation='vertical', spacing=8, size_hint_y=None)
        inner.bind(minimum_height=inner.setter('height'))
        for key, label in labels:
            inner.add_widget(Label(text=label + ':', color=(0.8, 0.8, 0.8, 1),
                                   size_hint_y=None, height='20dp'))
            hidden = key in ('slack_token', 'gmail_client_secret', 'gmail_refresh_token')
            ti = Factory.HedesInput(text=cfg.get(key, ''), password=hidden)
            inner.add_widget(ti)
            self.fields[key] = ti
        btn = Factory.HedesButton(text='SAVE SETTINGS')
        btn.bind(on_press=lambda x: self.save())
        inner.add_widget(btn)
        self.msg = Label(text='', color=(0.75, 0.75, 0.75, 1), size_hint_y=None, height='30dp')
        inner.add_widget(self.msg)
        scroll.add_widget(inner)
        self.content.add_widget(scroll)

    def save(self):
        cfg = load_config()
        for key, ti in self.fields.items():
            cfg[key] = ti.text.strip()
        save_config(cfg)
        audit('save_config', 'settings updated')
        self.msg.text = 'Settings saved on this device.'


class HedesApp(App):
    title = 'Hedes'

    def build(self):
        sm = ScreenManager()
        sm.add_widget(HomeScreen(name='home'))
        sm.add_widget(EmailScreen(name='email'))
        sm.add_widget(SlackScreen(name='slack'))
        sm.add_widget(FilesScreen(name='files'))
        sm.add_widget(WebScreen(name='web'))
        sm.add_widget(AuditScreen(name='audit'))
        sm.add_widget(SetupScreen(name='setup'))
        return sm


if __name__ == '__main__':
    HedesApp().run()
